verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile ships Copilot-powered code review analysis and suggestions, Copilot Q&A that provides insights into public/private repos, and Copilot cloud agent task management, directly delivering AI-generated insights/suggestions from the user's data within the app. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of these specific Copilot features' quality (community evidence is older and predates these AI features, so no real-world validation exists).
